name: tilicho-ai-labs
description: Multi-model AI-SDLC orchestration for Claude Code.

plugins.name: mmo
plugins.description: Runs a multi-model SDLC pipeline against a project brief. Routes judgment phases to Claude and mechanical phases to a cost-efficient model per policy, and reports what the run spent.

plugins.name: zero-touch
plugins.description: Zero-touch for the mmo plugin, in two modes, with no commands to learn. Workflow mode: a plain-words request for a job (a new app, a bug fix, a feature, tests, docs) starts its full workflow with approval steps. Hand-off mode: the chat's own model does the development, and new documents, tests and repeated changes are handed to the model you chose and checked automatically. Choose in the chat: type "change zero-touch settings" (the first chat after install asks). Enable or disable this plugin to switch zero-touch on or off; changes apply to new chats.
